name: Hologram
description: The first clip turns into a flickering hologram with scanlines and jittering rows, breaks up, and the hologram resolves into the second clip in full color. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: background
params.description: Color behind the hologram, seen between its scanlines and where it breaks up

params.name: scanlines
params.description: Number of scanlines over the frame height

params.name: jitter
params.description: How far rows of the hologram jump sideways, relative to the frame width

params.name: flicker
params.description: Strength of the flicker and of the rows that drop out
